abilities.name: Artistic Ingenuity
abilities.description: Uses Mehrak's mapping ability for offensive purposes, initiating a radial scan that deals AoE Dendro DMG. It will also scan all Dendro Cores in its AoE and cause them to immediately burst.

abilities.name: Painted Dome
_curatorNotes: Painted Dome grants Kaveh a 12s self-status (burstDuration = 720 frames): normal/charged/plunge attack AoE increased, DMG converted to Dendro, resistance to interruption increased. Status cancels immediately on swap (OnCharacterSwap handler in burst.go deletes burstKey). No spawned entity — behavior: 'instant' per recipe. duration: 12 left as generator artifact; reviewer to decide field placement.

Bloom/Lunar-Bloom damage bonus: while Painted Dome is active, all party members' Bloom reactions deal additional DMG (~27.5% at L1, scaling in burstDmgBonus[] in kaveh_gen.go). This team-wide buff is not represented in effects[]. Reviewer to author.
abilities.description:
Completely unleashes Mehrak's energy and creates a cubic scanned space, dealing AoE Dendro DMG to all opponents within it, causing all Dendro Cores in its AoE to immediately burst, and granting Kaveh the following enhanced combat abilities for a specific duration:
· Increases Kaveh's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attack AoE, and converts his attack DMG to Dendro DMG that cannot be overridden.
· All Dendro Cores created by all your own party members through Bloom and Lunar-Bloom reactions will deal additional DMG when they burst.
· Increases Kaveh's resistance to interruption.
These effects will be canceled once Kaveh leaves the field.

passives.name: An Architect's Undertaking
_curatorNotes: 2026-05-09 model-mismatch cleanup: rewrote from `damage em 300 target:enemy` to `heal self em 300`. Trigger remains manual: gcsim a1() fires on onPlayerHit (Kaveh hit by a Bloom/Hyperbloom/Burgeon-tagged attack), 0.5s ICD — no onPlayerHit + reaction-tag primitive yet; reviewer to wire.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). passive: An Architect's Undertaking — effects[0] (heal em 300) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `~/Code/gcsim/internal/characters/kaveh/asc.go:18-46` — `a1` subscribes to `OnPlayerHit`, returns unless the hit character is Kaveh AND the attack's tag is `AttackTagBloom`, `AttackTagHyperbloom` or `AttackTagBurgeon`, then heals `3.0 × EM` behind a 30-frame (0.5s) status. that gcsim's real hook is `OnPlayerHit` with a reaction-tag filter — we fire on the REACTION instead, because nothing models the player taking damage — and must drop the "no onPlayerHit + reaction-tag primitive yet; reviewer to wire" line. `source: 'team'` is deliberate: gcsim applies no actor filter, so a teammate's core heals him too. ⚠️ The surface bought here is the Team Builder's heal facet + badge + coverage row (a `heal` draws nothing in the planner), so the over-claim lands on Kaveh's healer chip: our model heals on every qualifying reaction, in-game only on the ones whose core reaches him. ⚠️ `lunarBloom` is deliberately ABSENT — the A1 text names only Bloom/Burgeon/Hyperbloom while Kaveh's BURST text names Lunar-Bloom explicitly, so the kit distinguishes them; per the reaction-conversion ruling a buff on the base is not a buff on the converted reaction, and Kaveh going dark on a Lunar-Bloom team is the correct, documented consequence. ⚠️ Lint B.12d requires the `source` field — it is present.
passives.description: When DMG dealt by a Dendro Core (including DMG from Burgeon and Hyperbloom) hits Kaveh, Kaveh will regain HP equal to 300% of his Elemental Mastery. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.
passives.caveat: Kaveh heals only when the Dendro Core actually bursts on him; every Bloom, Burgeon and Hyperbloom in the party counts here.

passives.name: A Craftsman's Curious Conceptions
_curatorNotes: Trigger: 'manual' — likely onHit (OnEnemyHit in asc.go a4AddStacksHandler) with conditions: ability in [normalAttack, chargedAttack, plungeAttack] (AttackTagNormal/Extra/Plunge), requires Painted Dome active (burstKey check). ICD: 0.1s (6 frames, a4ICDKey). Max 4 stacks of 25 EM each (a4Stacks capped at 4). Stack count resets on Q cast (c.a4Stacks = 0 in Burst()). Stat mod lasts for full Painted Dome window via modifier.NewBaseWithHitlag(a4Key, burstDuration = 720). Target scope: self. Reviewer to decide stack representation and condition authoring.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). passive: A Craftsman's Curious Conceptions — effects[0] (buff em 25) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `~/Code/gcsim/internal/characters/kaveh/asc.go:60-87` — `a4AddStacksHandler` is an `OnEnemyHit` hook: Kaveh's own Normal/Extra/Plunge tag, `burstKey` active, 6-frame ICD, `a4Stacks` capped at 4. `asc.go:48-58` is one EM StatMod worth `25 × a4Stacks` that lives for `burstDuration`. `burst.go:34` zeroes `a4Stacks` at the cast; `burst.go:52-70` adds `burstKey` for `burstDuration = 720` at `burstHitmark = 36`; `burst.go:80-89` deletes it on swap. that 100 is `4 × 25`, both numbers the kit states, authored at the max-stack peak (the documented `perStack`-not-expressible convention); that the span is the Painted Dome window measured from the cast — `burstKey` is added at the 36f hitmark and runs 720f, so 756f = **12.6s** from the anchor (the Faruzan/Bennett "honest length from the anchor" ruling); and that the 0.1s per-stack ICD and the stack reset at the Q cast are folded into that anchor. ⚠️ Two over-claims, both stated in the caveat: the ~3.5s ramp (four N-swings at Kaveh's cadence, not the 0.1s ICD) and the fact that Painted Dome dies on swap while this bar does not. ⚠️ The EXACT model (a `gainStacks` key on `onHit`, a `consumeStacks … all` on the burst, and a `perStack` buff) was examined and REFUSED: it needs a "during Painted Dome" gate, the only gate available is `state: inStance`, and that requires converting the burst to `behavior: "stance"` — and the one trigger whose span is a state window, `onState`, drops `self`-target effects outright (`buffWindows.ts:1207` runs inside the team pass behind `targetsTeamOrActive`), so it would be a fresh orphan. ⏭ Separately worth raising: Painted Dome IS a stance in Xiao's exact sense (12s self-window, attack conversion, `terminatesOnSwap`) and its `duration: 12` is currently one of the stray instant-ability durations nothing reads, so the burst draws as an instant pill — a correction of its own, and the thing that would later unlock the stacks model.
passives.description:
During Painted Dome, after Kaveh's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents, his Elemental Mastery will increase by 25. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s. Max 4 stacks.
This effect will be canceled when Painted Dome's effects end.
passives.caveat: Kaveh reaches the full +100 Elemental Mastery after four Normal, Charged or Plunging Attack hits inside Painted Dome; the bar shows it from the cast.
